title: Turn-end capture with an unchanged source voids a fresh acceptance evaluation (assumed_missing_baseline barrier)
outcome: A turn-end capture whose measured source id equals the source the evaluation judged does not become an unadmitted-change barrier, and a stale-evaluation remedy never tells the agent to end the turn when ending the turn is what creates the barrier.
acceptance: A fixture-reproduced turn-end capture whose measured source identity equals the source judged by a fresh evaluation does not report an assumed source change or invalidate that evaluation solely because the turn ended.
Real source changes and unavailable or mismatched source evidence retain conservative reporting and stale-evaluation protection; behavioral controls distinguish them from the unchanged case.

TermAl-owned stale-evaluation guidance, if any is changed, identifies a supported recovery action; the Engram-owned EndTurnReadAndRetry remedy and equal-revision barrier work is linked to Engram w-15932dbe53e2. Source-cause evidence, author RED/GREEN runs, cargo fmt --check and the whole independent review pair are recorded before integration handoff.
